items.title: The gfx and webview notices byte checks depended on clearlydefined.io: CI went red on the miniz_oxide block with no dependency changed
items.kind: harness (nondeterminism; network in a byte gate)
items.discussion: CI run 43519114590 (next 870ac2d2, 2026-11-13), job gfx: `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt differ: byte 174807, line 3645`; the run before it (052fe60c) was green on the same lockfile; fixed forward at next 923b9615
items.area: scripts/ci-local.sh (legs gfx and webview), crates/vilan-rt-gfx/about.toml, crates/vilan-rt-webview/about.toml, .github/workflows/ci.yml
items.body: cargo-about asks clearlydefined.io for licence data unless `--offline`, and that service answers differently once it harvests a new crate version; the gate compared its output byte for byte. FIX: both legs run `cargo fetch --locked` (the notices cover every platform's crates) and then `cargo about generate --offline`; the texts come from the crates' own files; both committed notices files are byte-identical to the offline output on this box. STILL OPEN: (1) confirm on CI that the offline path is green on a cold cache (the run on 923b9615 says). (2) The compiler's own notices (`cargo test -p vilan-cli --test third_party_notices`) check coverage of the lockfile, not bytes, so they are not exposed; the documented regeneration recipe in the root `about.toml`, `CLAUDE.md` and that test's message still says the online form: decide whether the root recipe should say `--offline` too (it changes what text a regeneration produces for crates clearlydefined knows better). (3) The release workflow: check whether it regenerates any notices online.
